name: magazine
label: Magazine: serif and sans mixed, colour and chapter cards, sound on the moves, no dead air
notes: Common short-form editing advice as one preset: a serif numeral, an italic serif word and sans text in one phrase; titles set around the head (left, right, chest, big over the face behind the head); olive and cream cards on lines to land and numbered chapter cards on a list, with numbers popping in around the head; a bed picked by the energy of what you say; a whoosh on transitions, a pop on text, a click on key moves, capped so they stay sparse; a 12% punch-in on every other cut, a typewriter entrance, soft crossfades; pauses over 0.3 s cut out.
